Leaders Arrested Ahead of Delhi Protests, Traffic Curbs in Place

Leaders of a movement described as a 'cockroach' movement were preventively arrested in Delhi ahead of planned protests. Traffic restrictions were also in place. The arrests and curbs occurred as demonstrations were anticipated.
